evidence.observation: call_log_exists is false for router log path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl despite active router status

findings.title: Potential empty fallback for API keys in emergency alert processing

evidence.observation: API keys for Gemini and Mistral fallback to empty string defaults (os.environ.get('...', '')) which could cause cryptic runtime authorization failures

proposed_action.description: Enforce explicit validation of GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variables prior to making provider calls.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents silent or obscure auth errors and enforces fail-fast behavior when required credentials are missing.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: security_gap; Evidence strength: strong; Confidence: 0.85; Risk: low; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Security fixes require expert review
